# ADR-038 — Phase 5 is Daily Command Center + Projects; Finance deferred to a later phase

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Phase 5 is **Daily Command Center + Projects** (Today/Home command center, operational project management, daily/weekly reviews, unified agenda, manual AI daily brief, mobile/Rabbit polish, gated deployment). **Finance is deferred to a later phase**, still gated on the open finance-source-of-truth decision. Supersedes the original `ARCHITECTURE.md` phase-plan numbering for Phase 5 only (user-approved 2026-08-21)
